newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Autolink bond provisional AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Autolink bond provisional AAA.

text.p: Standard & Poor's rating agency said on Tuesday it had assigned Autolink Concessionaires Plc's 125 million stg bond a provisional AAA rating.

"The rating expected to be assigned to the notes reflects the unconditional and irrevocable guarantee for the payment of scheduled interest and principal on the bond provided by Financial Security Assurance (UK) Ltd," S&P said in a statement.
S&P said the bond was being used to fund a portion of the construction costs associated with the M6/A74 road upgrade.

It said Autolink was owned by Autolink Holding (M6) limited, a joint venture between Amey Plc, Sir Robert McAlpine (Holdings) Limited, Taylor Woodrow Construction Limited, Barr Holdings Limited and Innisfree PFI fund.

"Overall, the manageable construction and operating programme, along with strong expected traffic growth should sustain adequate levels of debt service covergage for the underlying project," S&P said.
"Upon receipt of satisfactory legal opinions and final documentations, credit enhancement from FSA is expected to secure a rating of AAA on the bond issue itself."
For further information, please contact Caroline Shah from S&P in London on +44 171 826 3502.
